piezas.titulo: Reading words: News and social affairs
texto: Reading and spelling of news and media terminology: «ข่าว» has the high-class consonant ข with ่ (low tone). «ประชาชน» is a compound of «ประชา» (bprà-chaa, people) and «ชน» (chon, persons, with the final consonant น in the แม่กน group, mid tone). «สถานการณ์» combines «สถาน» (rising tone) and «การณ์» (with ณ silenced by the thantakhat). «ผลกระทบ» consists of «ผล» (with the final ล sounding as [n], rising tone) and «กระทบ» (low tone and high tone). Reading these spellings lets you understand news headlines and community reports.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «สื่อมวลชนนำเสนอข้อมูลสถิติเพื่อสะท้อนผลกระทบต่อคุณภาพชีวิตของประชาชน» express?

opciones.texto: The media present statistical data to reflect the impact on people's quality of life.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «สื่อมวลชนนำเสนอข้อมูลสถิติเพื่อสะท้อนผลกระทบต่อคุณภาพชีวิตของประชาชน» from the text.

opciones.texto: Following the news from several sources gives people a balanced understanding of events.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The agencies concerned issue statements clarifying the facts to prevent confusion.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «ผลกระทบ» (impact / effect), how is the final consonant ล of the syllable «ผล» pronounced?

opciones.texto: As the nasal alveolar consonant [n] (the แม่กน group)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the liquid consonant ล in final position of a syllable is pronounced as the nasal [n].
Incorrect: standard Thai does not allow a lateral [l] in final position.
Incorrect: ล belongs to the แม่กน group, not to แม่กบ.
